+title: session/cancel stops all work the session started, within seconds (cancel is kill)
+---
+## What
+A `session/cancel` is a command, close to kill. Today `cancelRunningPrompt` (Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Agent/PromptExecution.swift) calls only `entry.session.cancelForeground()`, which spares background runs on purpose. In oneplan24 django__django-13964 the root's child coder kept running a full test suite after the cancel. Router never sent `workEnded`, no `cancelled` idle came, and the harness waited its full 600 s before it killed the process (instance 9636 s).
+
+Change the cancel so it stops everything the session started:
+- Router: `RoutedSession.cancelAll()` in place of `cancelForeground()`. It also cancels each background run, such as a pending execute.
+- Agents: cancel the child agent runs of the session, and their children, without ending its scheduled agents. This needs the Agents API that is asked for in the Agents session.
+- The one exception: scheduled agents stay.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- After `session/cancel`, the session's `cancelled` idle comes within a few seconds, even while a child agent and a background shell command run.
+- Each child agent run of the session ends `cancelled`, and its background command stops.
+- The scheduled agents of the session stay saved and keep their timers.
+- Quit and close paths are checked for the same waiting, and fixed if they wait.
+
+## Tests
+- Failing test first: a root with a running child agent and a background command, then `session/cancel`, then expect the cancelled idle within the time limit and the child run cancelled.
+- A test that a scheduled agent of the session survives a cancel.
+
+## Workflow
+Blocked on the Agents API, a cancel of a caller's runs that keeps the schedules. Do not build or test while a bench run is live. #bug #bench
\ No newline at end of file
